node.statement: Now apply lem-maincb-stage1-raw-refinement to the already-complete datum of node 1.6.1. For m>1, its hypotheses are the complementary target t_1-projections, old and fresh extended t_1-inclusions, fixed amplifications, and projection, complementarity, map, and target-ambient bounds established in nodes 1.2-1.4 and recorded in 1.6.1, with t_1<=e_1; hence the literal sum map is an extended D_1*t_1-inclusion C^{m+1}->A, exactly matching the previously recorded d_raw. For m=1, the external lemma returns the supplied fresh inclusion C^2->A_fresh without changing codomain, and node 1.3 already gives it with the recorded defect C_pair*L*epsilon. Thus the raw-call datum exists before the inference and afterward its literal output is certified with its recorded defect; together with node 1.1 this yields the root contract.
